# USGBC Support Center

> > Official support hub for LEED certification, green building credentials, and U.S. Green Building Council membership resources.

This support center serves professionals pursuing LEED certification, LEED AP credentials, and sustainable building practices. It provides guidance on GBCI programs (SITES, PEER, TRUE), Arc performance platform, continuing education, billing, and certification mark usage.

## Key Topics

- LEED certification
- LEED credentials (Green Associate, AP with specialty)
- GBCI programs (SITES, TRUE, PEER)
- Arc performance platform
- Green building standards
- USGBC membership
- Continuing education and training
- Professional development
- Building certification process
- Sustainability metrics
- LEED for Cities and Communities
- LEED for Neighborhood Development
- Certification mark usage
- Pro Reviewer services

## Getting Started

- [USGBC Support Center Home](https://support.usgbc.org/): Main support portal for LEED certification guidance, green building resources, and help center access

## LEED Certification & GBCI Programs

- [GBCI Certification Programs](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/gbci-programs): Information on GBCI programs including SITES, TRUE, PEER, and other sustainability certification standards

## Education & Professional Development

- [LEED Education & Training](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/education): Course catalog for LEED training, continuing education credits, and professional credential preparation

## Membership & Account Management

- [USGBC Membership](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/membership): Membership benefits, individual and organizational membership options, and account management
- [Billing & Payments](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/billing): Payment processing for LEED certification fees, exam costs, membership dues, and invoicing

## Optional

- [Marketing & Branding Guidelines](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/marketing): LEED certification mark usage policies, branding guidelines, and promotional material standards
